display.purpose: Sol counter, page titles, and high-level orientation headings.

body.purpose: Explanations, baseline narratives, and RAG scientific literature responses.

label.purpose: Units (BPM, mmHg, mGy, mSv), timestamps, and provenance tags.

shadows.name: hero-glow
shadows.purpose: Subtle ambient illumination behind Interactive Human Body SVG.

motion.name: ease-calm
motion.purpose: Smooth transitions when switching body regions, hazard modules, or tabs.

components.name: Primary Pill CTA Button
components.css: .mc-btn-primary { background: #EEF0F6; color: #040404; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; border: none; cursor: pointer; } .mc-btn-primary:hover { background: #FAF9FA; box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(165, 216, 255, 0.28); }

components.name: Secondary Pill Button
components.description: Dark navy pill button for supporting actions and tab pills.
components.css: .mc-btn-secondary { background: #121522; color: #FAF9FA; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Habitat Surface Card
components.css: .mc-card { background: #121522; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -8px rgba(4, 6, 16, 0.72); }

components.name: Semantic Status Badge
components.css: .mc-badge-warn { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.14); color: #FBBF24; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Top Navigation Pill
components.css: .mc-nav-active { background: #EEF0F6; color: #040404; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; }

narrative.overview: MarsCare AI pairs an approachable, calm spacecraft medical companion interface with the autonomous TARSCARE AI backend, prioritizing immediate 3-question triage and an interactive human body explorer.
keyCharacteristics: Subtle #A5D8FF ambient illumination focused behind the Interactive Human Body centerpiece.
Off-white #EEF0F6 pill buttons with #040404 ink keeping interactive controls visually distinct from Green/Amber/Red medical status cues.
Self-hosted Host Grotesk Variable typography with strict tabular numerals on vitals and dosimetry.

rules.name: The Neutral Chrome / Semantic Status Exclusivity Rule
rules.body: Neutral buttons and cards stay neutral (#EEF0F6 / #121522); Green, Amber, and Red appear solely for health risk classifications and Earth communication link state.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Every numeric readout, Sol counter, baseline delta, and table column applies tabular-nums so figures align vertically.

rules.name: The Focused Hero Illumination Rule
rules.body: Use soft #A5D8FF ambient radial glow sparingly behind the Interactive Human Body centerpiece rather than decorating every card.

dos: Do show explicit data provenance (Simulated Data, User-Entered Data, Real Research Data).
Do keep core medical evaluation, body exploration, and RAG explanations fully operational offline.
donts: Don't represent Earth atmospheric radiation (NASA RDP/ARMAS) as direct Mars exposure data.
Don't diagnose psychiatric disorders or infections automatically, or prescribe medications.
